original_pointwise_mathematics.graph_target: Unsigned shifted endpoints decode to m+lambda*N and m+Delta+lambda*N before positive subtraction, with all implemented arithmetic errors separately guarded and propagated.

original_pointwise_mathematics.external_mass_and_decoding: Only the original outer mass is external; normalised inner law approximation is charged through D_N. The monetary coverage-event bound adds estimator error once.
original_pointwise_mathematics.registered_selection: All 48 exact rational models satisfy positive weights summing to one and weighted-centred drift and loading identities. All 48 architecture minima and four full-pool winners agree with the retained selections. Source, protocol, dependency and scalar-input hashes agree.

line_level_findings.finding: The file ends with literal backslash-n characters after its closing brace, rather than a real newline. json.loads raises Extra data. Correct the final terminator before packaging; resource JSON and gzip evidence are unaffected.

The pointwise graph probability error charges outer log-endpoint errors with the unsmoothed payoff slope. This is sound but unnecessarily pessimistic for a mean certificate. A smoothing-first certificate for the identical circuit can charge the outer errors using the conditional-price slope nu0/lambda. The final strongest-rival comparison should rebuild budgets, priors and QPE plans with the smaller valid bound.

Every winning exp width equals the largest registered value ten. The finite result must not be described as a global raw-pricing or precision optimum. The existing text already discloses this limitation.

originality_and_advantage: All clamp, smoothing, CDF, variation and rounding mechanisms are established mathematical principles. This review proves project-specific finite implementation identities and bounds; it does not establish theoretical priority, physical quantum advantage or superiority over unregistered competitors.
